title: Exitonly Bitcoin Challenge 14
series: Exitonly "Bitcoin Challenge", 16 numbered episodes, 15 already spent

prize.note: single P2WPKH escrow, one funding transaction

target_format: BIP39 12 words (English), 7 given in clear, 5 missing, most likely BIP84 m/84'/0'/0'/0/0 (script type v0_p2wpkh), no passphrase stated, positions and order of the missing words not confirmed by the author

derivation.summary: combine the 7 published words with 5 unknown words into a checksum-valid BIP39 mnemonic and derive it to a Bitcoin address
derivation.certified_against: the public BIP39/BIP84 test vectors, since no episode of this series has a publicly known solved seed

difficulty_note: the brute-force space with known word positions is 2048^4 x 128 = 2,251,799,813,685,248 candidates; at an assumed 1,000,000 to 5,000,000 derivations/second on a rented GPU the cost is roughly $31,000 to $156,000 against an $18.90 prize, about 1,600 to 8,300 times over

leads.title: Solve episode #12 and compare its seed to #13 to test for a weak or correlated random source
leads.cost: about 10 minutes of GPU time, low prior

leads.title: Recover the complete solved seeds of episodes #11-#13, currently not recorded

third_party_material: The challenge video, its frames, and its audio are not included, since they are the author's copyrighted YouTube content; the video is linked by ID only. The 7 published seed words and short quotes from the description and comments are the author's own public material, reproduced in clues/author-posts.md.
